name: HappyMOMents Pathway to Employment: Wellbeing, Skills & Work Experience Programme for Vulnerable Women
whoFor: Women from vulnerable backgrounds who want to develop skills, build confidence and take first steps towards work in education (early years) or retail.
eligibility: Economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
gate: Is economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
referralRoutes: Through the HappyMOMents website (referral page due early October 2026)

selfReferral.note: Via the organisation's website once the referral page is live

projects.name: Pathway to Employment: Wellbeing, Skills & Work Experience Programme
projects.overview: Introduction to Early Years, paediatric first aid, mental health courses, hands-on experience working with children and families, and face-to-face professional development courses. Childcare and transport support is provided.
projects.duration: Two to three half-days a week for 15 weeks
where: Saviletown Children's Centre, Pentland I&N School, Pentland Road, Dewsbury, WF12 9JR

workExperience: Yes - hands-on experience working with children and families
notes: Status before November 2026: Referrals via the organisation's website, expected from early October 2026

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026)
provenance.evidence: Eligibility set to the Healthy Working Life grant funding criteria by the programme team (2 November 2026): Kirklees resident, economically inactive, right to work in the UK, health condition or disability, 18+ unless the scheme says otherwise.
